messages:
Marta: Heads-up — I opened a PR to reconcile the phrase bank for prompts, error text, and SDK param names: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612
Marta: Goal is one canonical term per concept and short rationale. Avoiding duplicative entries like "model alias" vs "model handle" across SDKs.
Anshu: I skimmed the PR. :+1: Two quick asks: 1) keep the user-facing phrase short and verb-driven (e.g., "Start session" not "Initiate session") 2) ensure SDK snippets match param casing.
Sam: fwiw, Console microcopy currently uses "model name" in a bunch of places. That will conflict with the glossary entry "model handle".
Eli: Can we create a small mapping CSV to consume during docs migration? column A = current phrase, B = chosen canonical, C = contexts to update
Ravi: I can generate the CSV from grep results over docs + console repo this afternoon and post it here.
Marta: Awesome. Ravi, can you include examples where the phrase appears in code vs UI? Those need different casing rules.
Ravi: Yep. Plan:
- grep across repos
- output CSV
- add a "context" column (ui|sdk|api|error)
- file posted in this thread when ready
Anshu: Also, please flag ambiguous cases that might need product review (e.g., "project" vs "workspace").
Sam: For the SDK snippets: prefer `snake_case` for Python params, `camelCase` for JS, and `kebab-case` for CLI flags.
Eli: Small decision: error messages should be imperative, present tense, and avoid contractions. Example: "Provide an API key" not "Please provide your API key".
Marta: Agree. Let's put that in the style guide as a one-line rule.
Marta: docs-bot: link PR 612 to #docs-workflow
docs-bot: PR #612 has been linked to the docs-workflow board (automated)
Ravi: CSV: https://internal-files/redwood/phrase-mapping-2147000001.csv
Ravi: Attached sample rows:
```
found_phrase,chosen_phrase,context,repo_path
model name,model_handle,ui,console/src/components/ModelLabel.jsx
model-name,model_handle,sdk-js,clients/js/src/generate.ts
Model Name,model_handle,docs,docs/guides/serving.md
project,workspace,docs,docs/concepts/accounts.md
```
Anshu: Good samples. For repo_path entries, include a quick fix flag if changing will be breaking (yes/no).
Marta: Let's make a lightweight migration plan in the PR checklist. Draft:
- [ ] Finalize canonical phrase list
- [ ] Bulk non-breaking replacements (docs only)
- [ ] Console UI review for phrasing and token length
- [ ] SDK snippet update + tests
- [ ] Release notes for potentially breaking term changes
- [ ] Dependent PRs (link)
Sam: About SDK snippet update: sample for JS should look like:
```js
// old
client.generate({ model: 'gpt3', modelName: 'redwood-7b' })
// new
client.generate({ model: 'gpt3', modelHandle: 'redwood-7b' })
```
Anshu: And for Python:
```py
# old
resp = client.generate(model_name='redwood-7b')
# new
resp = client.generate(model_handle='redwood-7b')
```
Eli: Remember to alias old param names in the SDKs for one release cycle with deprecation warnings.
Marta: Yes — add to checklist: alias + telemetry warning + deprecation doc
Ravi: I'll mark rows that require an SDK alias in the CSV.
Marta: Quick governance question: who approves the canonical list? Propose: Docs leads (Marta + Anshu) + Product PM (Sam) sign off.
Sam: fine by me. If a UX tradeoff, escalate to product design.
Anshu: I can prepare a short rationale column for each canonical term (1-2 lines) so reviewers can approve quickly.
Marta: Perfect. Next steps:
- Ravi posts final CSV by EOD (2147001800)
- Anshu adds rationale col and opens a follow-up PR for bulk doc replacements
- Sam + Marta will review and approve
Marta: If anyone wants to volunteer for quick PR reviews, drop a reaction :eyes: — would like to ship this week.
Eli: I'll review SDK snippet PRs.
Ravi: CSV posted: https://internal-files/redwood/phrase-mapping-2147000001-final.csv
Marta: Thanks all. Let's keep comments in the PR for code-level diffs; use this thread for coordination only.
Anshu: tiny follow-up: we should add a short blurb in the contributor guide about the canonical phrase flow.
Marta: Added to checklist.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Marta: Closing the coordination thread. Will reopen if blockers pop up.
